worldcombat.skill.rockblast.summary: Tears stones out of the ground and hurls them one after another on a low arc at the chosen landing zone: each stone only strikes once it truly connects and kicks up rubble dust at the real impact. Stones scatter, so only up close does the whole burst connect; aim at an entity, a ground point or a raised direction and walls will truly stop the stones. The boulder choice is fewer and heavier, tighter and steeper.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.use.0: A burst of arcing heavy stones at close-mid range
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.use.1: Aim at a landing zone to press a moving target
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.use.2: Use the boulder choice to pile single-stone damage on a thick target
Each stone deals about %1$s physical damage, and the burst tears out %2$s stones (2-5 natively, set by the user's data).
Stones are hurled every %1$s at %2$s blocks/tick on an arc, reaching %3$s blocks with up to ±%4$s spread.
Each stone has a %1$s block hit radius and falls at %2$s blocks/tick^2.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.boulder.on: Boulder: per-stone power x1.4, larger stones, spread x0.6 and a steeper arc; costs a burst capped at 3 stones, interval +2 ticks, stone speed x0.92, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.boulder.off: Shatter burst: up to 5 stones, interval -1 tick and a faster throw; costs per-stone power x0.85, smaller stones and spread x1.2.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-stone power rises to %2$s and the burst grows to %3$s stones.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-stone power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.preference.b: On: per-stone power x1.4, larger stones, spread x0.6 and a steeper arc for a single thick target; costs a burst capped at 3 stones, interval +2 ticks, stone speed x0.92, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off (shatter burst): up to 5 stones, a tighter interval and a faster throw, at the cost of per-stone power x0.85, smaller stones and spread x1.2.
worldcombat.skill.rockblast.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank higher so the burst finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
Whether it strikes an enemy or a hard surface, each stone kicks up rubble dust at the real impact and never replaces terrain; the dust lingers briefly, shorter and fainter when the hit is refused or the stone spends itself.
